title: MPESB PNST Result 2026 – Out
postName: Pre Nursing Selection Test (PNST) – Nursing Admissions 2026
vacancyDetails: Result of PNST 2026 for admission to nursing courses in Madhya Pradesh as per MPESB counselling rules
qualification: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology (or as per PNST / nursing admission rules)
ageLimit: As per Madhya Pradesh nursing admission / PNST notification
applicationFee: As per MPESB PNST online form fee
selectionProcess: PNST Examination → Result / Merit Rank → Online Counselling / Choice Filling → Seat Allotment
documentsRequired: Application number; Class 10 & 12 marksheets, domicile, category certificate, photo ID for counselling
howToApply:
1. Visit https://esb.mp.gov.in
2. Open PNST / Nursing Admissions Result 2026
3. Login and download scorecard / rank
4. Note counselling schedule
5. Participate in allotment rounds as per merit
shortDescription: MPESB Nursing Admissions PNST Result 2026 out. Check rank and scorecard at esb.mp.gov.in.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has declared the PNST (Pre Nursing Selection Test) Result 2026 for nursing admissions.

Qualified candidates can download their scorecard / merit rank from the MPESB portal and take part in online counselling and seat allotment as per the official schedule.

After result

  • Download scorecard and keep printouts
  • Register for counselling if required
  • Fill college choices carefully
  • Report to allotted institute with original documents

Use only esb.mp.gov.in for result and counselling links.
